Ladakh calling! Our group of six had long dreamt of this trip, and Siddharth made it happen with a perfectly planned itinerary, smooth bookings, and great local support.

Despite the challenging conditions in Ladakh, everything went seamlessly. Over eight unforgettable days, we explored Leh, Nubra Valley, Thang Village, and Pangong — each place more surreal than the last.

A few of us faced acclimatisation issues, but Siddharth’s efficient team and the warmth of the Ladakhi people helped us recover quickly.

A big thanks to Siddharth for his flawless planning and execution — highly recommended for anyone seeking an authentic Ladakh experience!

We approached Siddharth of Ladakh Calling for our family trip(4 adults, 2 teens and 2 younger kids) that was suggested by a good friend for our 10days ladakh trip between April 30 to May 9, 2023.

Siddharth pays attention to what and how we want to do the trip and chalks out an itinerary accordingly end to end(stay, transport, emergency planning including oxygen cylinders), pre-tour briefing and also provides his valuable inputs whenever we have a question or concern during the trip.

When we planned the trip, weather forecast for our trip days seemed good. But as we got close, the weather wasn’t that great. Siddharth helped us in this regard out of his way in making sure we were comfortable although some places like Tso Moriri are really remote with only basic facilities.

I highly recommend seeking Siddharth’s assistance for your Ladakh trip. Since he has travelled quite a bit and stayed in Bangalore for sometime, he understands the folks and sets the right expectations, particularly since Ladakh is not always a easy trip.

Ladakh Calling run by Siddharth is a reliable travel company, we have been using since the last 5 years, being a local ladakhi who has traveled in India and is aware about the needs of the traveller and takes personal care about their trip to Ladakh.

We used Ladakh calling for couple of treks. Good planing and advice, very knowledgeable, comparative prices, the two guides that he arranged for us for both treks were excellent and above all very reliable service with no fault.
Great experience nice arrangement ....सिध्दार्थ good work
